description.from:
**Files:** `src/store/embed.rs` (new: `Embedder` trait — model id, dim 384, batch embed; `StubEmbedder` — deterministic token-hash 384-dim normalized vectors with signed token buckets so shared vocabulary scores high cosine, good enough for the fixture scenarios); `src/store/vector.rs` (new: vec0 k-NN + cosine scores); `src/store/query.rs` (hybrid merge via reciprocal-rank fusion, deterministic); `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`.

**Specs turned green:** `08_vector_search.feature` — remove its @wip.

**Acceptance:** the embedder is a store-open concern (default None → semantic queries return a clean empty result, text queries unaffected); meta model id set on first embed, a mismatched model refused with a clean error; hybrid merge of FTS + k-NN results via reciprocal-rank fusion, composable with filters, one ranked result type for both paths; engine invisible.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
description.to:
**Files:** `src/store/embed.rs` (new: `Embedder` trait — model id, dim 384, batch embed; `StubEmbedder` kept solely as an internal unit-test seam), `src/store/vector.rs` (new: vec0 k-NN + cosine scores), `src/store/query.rs` (hybrid merge via reciprocal-rank fusion, deterministic), `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`.

**Specs turned green:** `08_vector_search.feature` — remove its @wip.

**Acceptance:** per Ryan's decision (BOTSPY-bb60bb closed): `08_vector_search.feature` exercises the REAL all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedder — the deterministic stub is never the shipped embedder and never drives vector/semantic search specs (internal unit tests only). The embedder is a store-open concern (no embedder configured → semantic queries return a clean empty result, text queries unaffected); meta model id set on first embed, a mismatched model refused with a clean error; hybrid merge of FTS + k-NN results via reciprocal-rank fusion, composable with filters, one ranked result type for both paths; engine invisible.
